intro.text: Hrm. Don't mind me. Just an old man who's lost his key.

lost.text: The key to my storeroom. I was oiling the doors in the yard behind me this morning, and now it's gone. My knees won't let me crawl about looking for it.

accepted.text: Would you? It's a small rusty thing. Probably still in the yard somewhere. The wooden door's open to anyone, just press on it.

refused.text: Aye, everyone is. If you change your mind, I'll be here. Where else would I go?

waiting.text: Any luck with my key? It'll be in the yard behind me, I'm sure of it.

choices.text: Where exactly did you lose it?

hint.text: I sat down at the little table for a rest. Southwest corner, I think. Then I got up and it was gone.

has_key.text: Is that... you've got my key!

keepers.text: That's not funny. That's my storeroom, that is.

returned.text: Bless you. Here, take this for your trouble. Ten gold. And I've opened the storeroom, go and have a look if you like. Just don't drink all of Tess's cider.

thanks.text: My favourite person! The storeroom's open, it's the little shed right there. Help yourself to anything in the chest.
